xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5364: Merge train board: a voided rebuild sits on top while the batch that merged is buried, and voided batches never age out

plan.title: Merge train board: a voided rebuild sits on top while the batch that merged is buried, and voided batches never age out
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 33 files_scope entries: 14 production files (store, promote, payload, board selection, 5 frontend train modules), 13 test files and fixtures, 5 doc files and the frontend test subset list. It is one vertical change to how the board selects and presents a chain; the server age-out could ship alone, but the outcome hero and covered rule are only correct after a churn burst when the server keeps the newest merge in the payload, so the slices land together.

narratives.Problem: After a batch merges, the merge train card has no hero; a rebuild voided by that very merge sorts above the merged batch and reads as unmerged work, and voided batches stay on the card until ten newer batches exist, however old they are (a churn burst can push the merged batch out of the 10 entirely).
narratives.Proposal: Record voidedBy (structured, new voided_by column) when promote voids a sibling and carry it in the payload; select the board chain server-side with a 24-hour age-out for voided/merged batches while always keeping the newest merge; on the card, show the merged batch as an outcome hero when nothing live remains and nothing happened after the merge, fold rebuilds voided by that merge under it, hide voided batches whose features all merged later behind show, collapse identical voided runs into one row, and cap the older list at three rows. Full detail in .pan/drafts/pan-5364.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Reducing rebuild churn (PAN-5356, PAN-5357)
- Deleting or rewriting generation rows, backfilling voided_by, or parsing statusReason strings
- Changing /api/merge-train/generations or the FeatureItem badge
- Changing the keep=3 trim in cleanupUatGenerations
- Changing promote, supersede or reconciler behavior beyond writing voidedBy
- Hiding, folding or collapsing superseded or failed batches
- Changing the Retry batch assembly rule (stays keyed on the live hero)
- Changing RecentMergesStrip

autoDecisions.summary: No backfill of voided_by; legacy rows are handled by the covered-by-merge rule and age out after 24 hours
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to key on structured data, not the reason string; the covered rule needs no parsing and the age-out clears old rows within a day.

autoDecisions.summary: Implement the optional 24-hour age-out, in the board payload only (/api/merge-train/generations unchanged)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue title and the operator's question are about how long batches stay; the FeatureItem badge reads the other endpoint and must keep its data. Rows stay in the database as the audit trail.

autoDecisions.summary: Reverse PAN-4753 FR-7 ('none is hidden') for voided batches only; superseded and failed stay always visible
autoDecisions.rationale: Superseded batches are promotable and failed ones drive Retry batch assembly; every hidden voided batch stays reachable through a show control.

autoDecisions.summary: Outcome hero shows only when no live batch exists and no batch changed after the merge except rebuilds that merge voided or voided batches it covers
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's 'newest event is a promote' rule while tolerating siblings voided a few seconds after the merge stamp.

autoDecisions.summary: Promoted badge reads 'merged' (success tone) when the project has no version sync
autoDecisions.rationale: The server always sends shipStatus null, so the outcome hero would otherwise say 'version not shipped' in warning tone on every project.

autoDecisions.summary: Copy uses shortName (strips only 'uat/'), e.g. pan-train-moss-1115-12
